title: Avial
description: A medley of mixed vegetables simmered and folded into a coconut-yogurt paste, finished with coconut oil and curry leaves — a Kerala classic, mild and hearty.

ingredients.name: Raw Banana
ingredients.notes: cut into batons, or substitute with potato

steps: In a pot, combine the carrot, beans, raw banana, drumstick and pumpkin with the turmeric, salt and water. Cook covered over medium heat for 10-12 minutes until the vegetables are just tender, not mushy.
Meanwhile, grind the grated coconut, cumin seeds and green chillies together to a coarse paste, adding a splash of water if needed.
Once the vegetables are cooked and most of the water has evaporated, stir in the coconut paste and mix well.
Simmer for 3-4 minutes, then turn off the heat and stir in the curd, mixing gently so it doesn't split.
Drizzle over the coconut oil and scatter the curry leaves on top without stirring further — avial is traditionally finished this way, with the raw coconut oil's aroma left intact.
